user_question: Create a choropleth map of total hospital beds across Centre County.

outputs.summary: Workflow completed with accepted terminal artifacts.

workflow_plan.goal: Create a choropleth map of total hospital beds across Centre County.

workflow_steps.title: Aggregate hospital beds by tract
workflow_steps.purpose: Compute total hospital beds within each Centre County tract.
workflow_steps.instructions: Use the hospital point layer and tract polygon layer. Sum the BEDS field for points within each tract and write the result to an output field named total_beds.

workflow_steps.title: Create hospital beds choropleth map
workflow_steps.purpose: Produce an interactive choropleth map showing total hospital beds by Centre County tract.
workflow_steps.instructions: Create an interactive HTML choropleth using the total_beds field from the aggregated tract layer. Use the county subdivisions layer as supplied boundary context and embed source and CRS verification metadata.
